name: authz
description: Multi-tenant isolation, IDOR and row-level security. Use to find every path where one tenant could read or write another tenant data: "we forgot to filter by org_id", "can users see each other data", "audit these endpoints for cross-tenant leaks", "make an unscoped query impossible". Covers scoped repositories, RLS, default-deny routing and the two-tenant test. For what the UI shows use ux.
